anchor_qualification: measured causal DEM and physical state; no future observations
anchor_snapshot: single full-world common control step; no asynchronous clock/RNG stitching; earliest step improving number of qualified parents; stop when all qualify or 20s
dem_flat_gradient: 2D least-squares plane over center +/-0.25m, >=16 validcells, slope norm < tan10deg
prefix_reset_reference: tile-local x in m; y/yaw zero, worldz actual generated mesh surface + defaultroot clearance; initial velocity zero
restoration_description: observable snapshot branch; PhysX contact warm-start caches not serialized
ruling: deadline980 selected before outcomes to reduce implementation and collection risk

uphill_before.rationale: inward from positive outer edge; measured qualification unchanged; reverse may boundary censor

descent.rationale: inverted stairs descend inward from negative edge
